evidence: Market reporting leading into December 2 shows Bitcoin attempting a modest relief rally above $4,000-$4,200 following its worst monthly drop in seven years. However, late-day coverage notes momentum already slowing, with prices dropping roughly $200 off intraday highs and analysts characterizing the move as a vulnerable dead-cat bounce amid prevailing macro bearish sentiment.
limitations: No live Yahoo Finance or tier-1 verified mainstream news items were available in the dataset; all evidence consists of unverified crypto blog feeds.
Multiple articles focus on retrospective monthly performance rather than high-conviction 24-hour forward catalysts.
Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
